prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was telling someone about that quick hop I took from Beijing over to Shanghai—felt like I barely sat down before we landed.
And in that same trip diary I mentioned how we wandered around Shanghai a bunch—those touristy spots were actually pretty fun.
Oh, and later on I had a separate work thing in Shenzhen, so I ended up talking about hotels there too.
My friend had already arranged the flight details for the Shanghai leg: it was Air China, flight CA1234, dated 2025-03-17, and the passenger name on it was Liu Yang.
For Shenzhen, the stay was already set too—Home Inn Futian CBD, checking in 2025-03-13 for 4 nights, and it was under Lin Bo.
